description: V.P. Susil Premaratne v. Hewawasampitabendi Badathurage Kantha Pushpakumara and Two Others V.P. Susil Premaratne v. Hewawasampitabendi Badathurage Kantha Pushpakumara and Two Others View More before Hon. Upaly Abeyrathne, J.
parties: V.P. Susil Premaratne v. Hewawasampitabendi Badathurage Kantha Pushpakumara and Two Others V.P. Susil Premaratne v. Hewawasampitabendi Badathurage Kantha Pushpakumara and Two Others View More
keywords: The Appellant challenged the Additional District Court’s order dismissing his action for declaration and permanent injunction after refusing an application for postponement. Held - Section 145 of the Civil Procedure Code did not empower the trial court to dismiss the action forthwith, but required it to proceed to decide the action on the available evidence. Held - Appeal allowed without costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka; Civil Procedure Code
